narrative.overview: This contract covers group conversation, mentions, information, creation and legacy group siblings. It replaces the former group layout without changing the rest of the desktop system. A reader identifies a person by portrait and name, understands who will receive a message, and finds optional management without leaving the conversation.
keyCharacteristics: One shell title and a compact participant toolbar.
A centered reading column shared with the composer.
Familiar message bubbles, existing portraits and restrained semantic color.
Readable names backed by exact, source-bound delivery identities.

rules.name: The Identity Rule
rules.body: Names and existing portraits identify people; background color does not encode a new member identity or delivery route.

dos: Do show the person before a protocol address.
Do preserve exact source, room and recipient authority behind readable names.
Do keep transcript and composer on the same content axis at every container width.
Do keep states, counts and historical attribution grounded in recorded facts.
donts: Don't repeat the main group title or restore a horizontal row of conversations.
Don't guess a recipient from a display name, including after paste or rename.
Don't label missing activity as successful completion or invent streamed text.
Don't replace journal, attachment, approval or retry owners during UI work.
